proposed_from.topic: K1 prove root-n W1 estimation of the quotient latent-effect law in the fixed-k Virk-Mazaheri-Wu proxy model through eigenvalue collisions. K2 construct honest cluster-adaptive W1 confidence sets. K3 prove labeled-weight error min{1,(sqrt(n)delta)^-1}. K4 match both regimes by local lower bounds. Include the explicit full-rank k=2 collision witness and PROTECT stage-III NSCLC consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: In the witness, proxy matrices remain nonsingular while effects .25-epsilon and .25+epsilon merge. Observable operators and auxiliary moments fluctuate at root-n scale. For a delta-wide cluster, projector-mass error of order 1/(sqrt(n)delta) is transported only across distance delta, suggesting root-n W1 cancellation even though labels fail. Bauer-Fike localization and aggregate cluster projectors provide a plausible proof spine. Exact collision, unequal weights, and delta near n^-1/2 showed no immediate contradiction; complex empirical eigenvalues remain unresolved. Separated submodels also provide a standard Gaussian local lower bound. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove a uniform operator-to-positive-measure perturbation lemma through simultaneous cluster merges and splits, including nonreal empirical spectra, then calibrate honest clustering and a matching local experiment. EARLY KILL TEST: Exhaust the two-by-two witness under all root-n moment perturbations. Stop if quotient W1 error contains any inverse-epsilon factor or construct two statistically root-n-close admissible operators whose quotient laws are separated by more than root-n.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: Virk--Mazaheri--Wu supplies moment identification and separated inverse-eigengap weight recovery. On the explicitly narrower uniformly conditioned causal VMW submodel, the proposed contribution is a gap-free observable-summary modulus for the quotient effect law, with root-\(n\) \(W_1\) estimation, honest diameter, well-posed cluster reporting, and matching same-class minimax bounds through changing multiplicity. The observed-margin proposition establishes only a one-way inclusion into the relevant VMW finite-sample domain; neither the converse nor a gap-free theorem on the full VMW class is claimed.

seed_details.anchor: VirkMazaheriWu2026, compressed pairing in Section 4, finite-sample theorem in Section 6, and Appendix G
seed_details.kernel: Prove a gap-free Lipschitz modulus from the conditioned observable VMW summary to the positive quotient effect law in \(W_1\), then match its root-\(n\) risk locally.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the simple-eigenvalue left-eigenvector step after Bauer--Fike localization by aggregate projector mass transport and positive-law repair.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the exact target--method pair using latent treatment effects, eigenvalue collision, Wasserstein, positive spectral repair, and nonnormal proxy operators returned no occupied result beyond the VMW anchor.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from VMW because its eigenvalues are already root-\(n\). Rebuttal: VMW itself requires disjoint isolation discs to recover masses; support localization alone does not produce a positive weighted law or control mass through merges.

seed_details.kernel: Invert a simultaneous observable-summary region to obtain honest root-\(n\)-diameter \(W_1\) sets and cluster reports whose label intervals widen at the testing boundary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a delta-method ellipsoid for labeled eigenpairs by inversion over the union of spectral multiplicity strata.
seed_details.destination_search: The adjacent confidence-set papers concern density smoothness or topic-model distance, not an estimated nonnormal causal operator with changing multiplicity.
seed_details.red_team: A constant Wasserstein ball is automatically honest. Rebuttal: the claimed set has uniformly root-\(n\) diameter and supplies separation-adaptive coordinate widths without preliminary conditioning.

seed_details.kernel: Prove that ordered latent weights have risk \(\min\{1,(\sqrt n\,\delta)^{-1}\}\) and construct a factorization-preserving local converse on the explicit two-class proxy witness.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain VMW's separated eigenvector perturbation above the noise scale, introduce a total fallback below it, and replace a generic mixture tangent by a proxy-factorization-preserving score attenuation path.
seed_details.destination_search: Ordinary finite-mixture singularity papers do not contain the VMW observable moments or its direct root-\(n\) operator channel.
seed_details.red_team: The rate is just Davis--Kahan with a clipped bound. Rebuttal: the upper inequality is only half the claim; the same-class local path must neutralize direct information about \(p\) and prove sharpness.

seed_details.kernel: Derive a uniform directional limit law for cluster support and aggregate projector mass as effects merge at \(n^{-1/2}\) scale.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After the joint moment central limit theorem, apply a set-valued spectral directional derivative instead of the ordinary simple-root delta method.
seed_details.destination_search: The closest Wasserstein directional-inference work treats topic-model transport, not a nonnormal proxy quotient operator.
seed_details.red_team: Finite-dimensional delta-method theory already covers it. Rebuttal: the eigenvalue and transport maps are nondifferentiable at multiplicity, and raw empirical eigenvalues can become nonreal.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize the semiparametric efficiency bound for \(\int\phi\,d\nu_P\) when \(\phi\) is analytic or polynomial, uniformly through effect multiplicity.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Differentiate the observable bilinear matrix functional directly rather than differentiating labeled roots and residues.
seed_details.destination_search: Proximal efficiency papers target marginal average effects; the searched VMW literature contains no efficiency calculation for latent-effect-law functionals.
seed_details.red_team: Polynomial functionals are already immediate from VMW moments. Rebuttal: identification is immediate, but the efficient influence function and collision-uniform attainment are not supplied.

seed_details.kernel: Estimate an unknown number of distinct effect atoms while retaining oracle \(W_1\) risk across rank and effect collisions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Combine empirical proxy-rank selection with positive moment-cone order selection before spectral extraction.
seed_details.destination_search: Wu--Yang adapt to Gaussian-mixture order, while VMW treats known \(k\); no joint proxy-rank and effect-multiplicity adaptation was located.
seed_details.red_team: This is routine singular-value thresholding. Rebuttal: latent cardinality, observable proxy rank, and the number of distinct effect atoms are different objects and collide on different strata.

seed_details.kernel: Map a prespecified finite latent-fitness stratification and bounded restricted-survival functional into inverse-censoring-weighted VMW moments and derive collision-robust inference.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the uncensored outcome-weighted proxy matrix by a justified bounded censoring-weighted moment before shared-subspace compression.
seed_details.destination_search: PROTECT uses a continuous latent parametric hazard model, so no existing paper establishes the required finite-class VMW correspondence.
seed_details.red_team: PROTECT already performs proxy-based treatment-effect inference. Rebuttal: its hazard estimand, latent model, and censoring likelihood are not the VMW quotient-law functional.

seed_details.anchor: VirkMazaheriWu2026, operator-moment equivalence theorem, and Kato1995
seed_details.kernel: Obtain a functional central limit theorem for the resolvent transform \(z\mapsto a(P)^\top(I-z\Delta Q(P))^{-1}c(P)\) on contours that may enclose colliding effects.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Differentiate the resolvent bilinear form on an externally fixed contour rather than diagonalizing individual eigenpairs.
seed_details.destination_search: Kato supplies analytic projectors but not a statistical process limit for VMW observable moments.
seed_details.red_team: This is a routine matrix delta method. Rebuttal: the fixed-contour process is routine away from the spectrum, so novelty depends on uniform contour selection across merging support; this weakness lowered its rank.

seed_details.kernel: Choose a treatment policy from the recovered latent-effect law and derive regret relative to an oracle latent-class rule.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: A policy score would require assigning a new patient to a latent class from observed proxies.
seed_details.destination_search: The VMW target is a marginal latent-effect law and supplies no identified new-unit class posterior or observable policy index.
seed_details.red_team: The oracle policy is not identified from the quotient law. The objection holds, so the seed was dropped rather than repaired by an unanchored classification assumption.

seed_details.kernel: Invert a permutation or conformal test to obtain finite-sample quotient-law coverage.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: A finite-sample symmetry group would have to preserve the observational treatment and proxy factorization under the null.
seed_details.destination_search: No exchangeability, known randomization group, placebo-unit symmetry, or time permutation is present in the VMW observational proxy experiment.
seed_details.red_team: The required symmetry is absent. The objection holds, so the seed was dropped instead of relabeling asymptotic moment inversion as conformal inference.

accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The gap-free modulus, estimation, inference, and minimax claims are only over the explicitly defined submodel M; they do not assert a result for the full VMW class, unknown k, or labeled recovery at equality.
